newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo '97 wheat crop above 3 mln T - agency.
newsitem.headline: Yugo '97 wheat crop above 3 mln T - agency.

text.p: The Serbian government said it expected wheat crop to exceed three million tonnes this year, state news agency Tanjug reported on Thursday.
The forecast was based on 55,000 hectares harvested so far with an average yield of 4.5 tonnes per hectare, the agency quoted a government statement as saying.
Official preliminary wheat forecasts stand at 2.8 million tonnes from an area of some 800,000 hectares with an average yield of 3.44 tonnes per hectare.
The expected crop is a significant increase on 1.5 million tonnes of wheat harvested from an area of 583,000 ha in 1996.
In the country's bread-basket of Vojvodina, which is expected to produce 1.356 million tonnes of wheat from some 356,000 ha, harvest was halted last Sunday by heavy rains and hail.
Analysts said the yield could generally be 10-15 percent lower. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom +381 11 311 4254
